[Story]
Xiaoxue is a capable and enthusiastic housewife. Old Pan is an old man who spends all day in the chess and card club, not caring about other things. One day, Xiaoxue passes by Old Pan's house, takes a look and says to Old Pan: "Uncle Pan, your garden is really a green paradise."

[Question]
What does Xiaoxue really want to say when she says this?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Xiaoxue implies that Old Pan should clean up the weeds in the garden.
B. Xiaoxue admires Old Pan's gardening skills.
C. She encourages Old Pan to plant other colored plants to make the garden more beautiful and colorful.
D. She admires that Old Pan's garden is very beautiful.
